edits.new:
AC7 (BR1): the worker polls `rwb-integration` in namespace `rwb-recovery` and carries the rwb-integration login only.
AC8 (BR2): every worker carries the build ID of its release and worker versioning is enabled, so a new build takes new runs while the old build drains.
AC9 (BR3): JOB-08 is started by `AceDataReady` only; no Schedule exists for it and the `job_catalog` row records the event trigger.
AC10 (BR4): the release writes `rwb_integration` only and holds no grant on `recovery` or on another `rwb_*` schema.
AC11 (BR5): the flag is the platform flag library's; off means a skipped run and no write.
AC12 (BR6): the backfill and the rerun are idempotent by job, business date and `Idempotency-Key`.
AC13 (BR7): every alert carries a message ID and the agreed text and links one runbook entry.
AC14 (BR8): no environment value is hard-coded; values come from values files and the flag library.
AC15 (BR9): dashboard series, alert payloads and the runbook carry no person's data and no decoded payload.
AC16 (BR10): a failing release never replaces a working one, and a half-applied run is picked up by the next business date.
AC17 (BR11): the package version in force is a registry value of rwb-decision and no version is pinned in a service table.
AC18 (BR12): no data lake, lake file or lake target is deployed by this release.
